intro: Urban Plates is the California fast-casual chain built on scratch-cooked, better-for-you food: chef-crafted plates of grilled cage-free chicken, grass-fed steak and sustainable salmon, braise bowls, big salads, sandwiches and an everyday value menu. You order at the counter and it is plated and brought out. Below is the full Urban Plates menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Urban Plates, a grilled cage-free chicken plate is about $20.99, a grass-fed steak plate $24.99, and sustainable salmon $24.99, each with sides. Braise bowls run $15.99 to $18.99, big salads $15.99 to $23.25, and sandwiches $15.50 to $19.50. A soup and salad combo is $11.99. It is upscale-casual, scratch-cooked food. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Urban Plates value: the soup and salad combo ($11.99), the half-sandwich combo ($12.50) and a cup of soup ($6.00) are the cheapest ways in, and the everyday value menu keeps several meals under $12. Most sides are $6.50. It is upscale-casual, so there is no dollar menu, but the value combos are the smart order. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a plate at Urban Plates?
faqs.a: A grilled cage-free chicken plate is about $20.99, a grass-fed steak plate $24.99, and sustainable salmon $24.99, each served with sides. Braise bowls are $15.99 to $18.99. The soup and salad combo ($11.99) is the value pick. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Urban Plates known for?
faqs.a: Urban Plates is a California fast-casual chain known for scratch-cooked, better-for-you food: chef-crafted plates of grilled cage-free chicken, grass-fed steak and sustainable salmon, braise bowls, and big salads, ordered at the counter and plated to order.

faqs.q: Does Urban Plates have a value menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Urban Plates runs an everyday value menu with several meals and combos under $12, including the soup and salad combo ($11.99) and the half-sandwich combo ($12.50). It is the smart way to eat there on a budget.

Urban Plates is health-focused but does not publish full per-item calorie counts, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Totals vary with the plate, the protein and the sides you choose.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Urban Plates?
faqs.a: Favorites include the grilled cage-free chicken plate, the grass-fed steak plate, the Moroccan chicken braise, the chicken Cobb salad, and the soup and salad combo.
